common.unknownError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

states.emptyDescription: No records match the current filters.
states.accessDeniedDescription: This page needs the "{permission}" permission. Ask an owner or admin to grant it to one of your roles.
states.notFoundDescription: The record you're looking for doesn't exist or was removed.

auth.loginSubtitle: Admin panel access for Kwt25 staff.
auth.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
auth.mfaUnsupported: This account requires two-factor authentication, which this admin panel doesn't support.

validation.passwordMin: Password must be at least {min} characters.
validation.money: Enter an amount in KD, e.g. 650 or 85000.500.
validation.titleRequired: Enter a title in at least one language.

properties.title: Properties
properties.description: All listings — drafts and published, for rent and for sale.
properties.newDescription: Create the listing first, then upload photos and publish.
properties.deleteDescription: "{title}" will be hidden everywhere. Nothing is hard-deleted — it can be restored from the database.
properties.created: Property created. Now add photos and publish.

fields.locationPickerHint: Click the map to drop the pin, or drag it — the coordinates fill in automatically.

hints.featured: Shown in "Our distinctive properties" on the home page.
hints.vip: Shown in the VIP row at the top of the home page.
hints.premium: Shows the gold ★ distinct badge on the card.

media.title: Photos
media.description: Upload photos, pick the main one, and drag the order the visitors will see.
media.dropHint: Drag & drop images here, or choose files.
media.empty: No photos yet. Listings publish without photos, but shouldn't.
media.deleteDescription: The photo will be removed from this property's gallery.

inquiries.title: Inquiries
inquiries.description: Messages from visitors — property pages, the contact page, and the home page.

requests.title: Property requests
requests.description: "Request your property" submissions — what visitors are looking for.

hints.code: A stable identifier used in URLs and the API. Leave empty to generate from the name.
hints.keyLocked: The key can't be changed after creation — the website filters on it. Rename the display name instead.

validation.nameRequired: Enter a name in at least one language.

areas.title: Areas
areas.description: Kuwait areas visitors can filter by (Salmiya, Hawally, …).
areas.formDescription: Name in both languages; the slug appears in storefront URLs.
areas.deactivateDescription: "{name}" will disappear from filters and forms. Existing properties keep it.

propertyTypes.title: Property types
propertyTypes.description: Villa, apartment, floor, land, office, chalet, commercial…
propertyTypes.formDescription: Name in both languages; the key is a stable identifier.
propertyTypes.deactivateDescription: "{name}" will disappear from filters and forms. Existing properties keep it.
propertyTypes.empty: No property types match these filters.

amenities.title: Amenities
amenities.description: Features shown as a checklist on property pages (central A/C, balcony, …).
amenities.formDescription: Name in both languages; the key is a stable identifier.
amenities.deactivateDescription: "{name}" will disappear from the property form. Existing properties keep it.

banners.title: Home banners
banners.description: The hero artwork at the top of the public home page.
banners.formDescription: Upload the artwork, describe it for screen readers, and choose where it links.
banners.hideDescription: It disappears from the home page immediately. The artwork is kept, so you can show it again later.
banners.emptyDescription: Upload one to take over the home-page hero. Until then the site shows its built-in artwork.
banners.summaryNone: No banner is live — the home page is showing its built-in artwork.
banners.summaryStatic: One live banner: the home page shows it as a static hero.
banners.summarySlider: {count} live banners: the home page rotates them as a slider.
banners.perLocaleHint: Alt text describes the image for screen readers and search engines. Only upload a per-language image when the artwork has text baked into it.

hints.image: Full-bleed at up to 3:1 — supply around 1920×640 so it stays sharp on a desktop monitor.
hints.href: A path on this site such as /smart-search, or a full URL. Leave empty for a banner that isn't clickable.
hints.window: Leave both empty to run the banner until you hide it.

validation.altRequired: Add alt text in at least one language.
validation.windowOrder: The end date must come after the start date.

users.title: Staff users
users.description: Accounts that can sign in to this admin panel.
users.createDescription: The account is created first, then you assign roles to it.

hints.emailImmutable: Email can't be changed after the account is created.
hints.passwordOnCreate: Set an initial password. The user should change it after first sign-in.
hints.isActive: Inactive accounts can't sign in. Accounts are deactivated, never deleted, because they're referenced by audit history.

users.empty: No staff users match these filters.
users.noSearchHint: Filter by account status; there is no name search.

roles.title: Assigned roles
roles.description: Roles grant permissions across the whole office.
roles.empty: No roles assigned. This user can sign in but won't see anything.
roles.revokeDescription: {role} will be removed from {name}. They immediately lose every permission it granted.
roles.assignAtCreationHint: Tick any roles to grant immediately. You can add or remove roles later from the user's page.
roles.assignFailedOnCreate: The user was created, but these roles couldn't be assigned: {roles}. Try assigning them again from the user's page.

roles.title: Roles & permissions
roles.description: Create roles and control which permissions each one grants.
roles.matrixDescription: Tick a permission to grant it to this role. Changes apply to everyone holding the role as soon as you save.
roles.dangerousHint: This permission allows destructive or privilege changes.
roles.confirmDescription: You're granting {granted} and revoking {revoked}. Everyone holding this role is affected immediately.
roles.createDescription: Set the role's name and starting permissions. You can change permissions later from the role's page.
roles.codePattern: Lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores only, starting with a letter (e.g. senior_agent).

hints.code: A stable identifier used internally — can't be changed after the role is created.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Office contact details and public-site copy, editable without a deploy.
settings.siteDescription: Phone, WhatsApp, and the site name in both languages. Saving updates the storefront immediately.
settings.socialDescription: Handle or full profile URL — the storefront accepts either.
settings.footerDescription: The line under the logo and the strip along the bottom of every page.
settings.heroDescription: Shown only when no banner is uploaded (Banners page) — an uploaded banner carries its own message and replaces this entirely.
settings.vipDescription: Leave a field blank to use the storefront's built-in text instead.
settings.featuredDescription: Leave a field blank to use the storefront's built-in text instead.
settings.allDescription: Leave a field blank to use the storefront's built-in text instead.
settings.typesDescription: Leave a field blank to use the storefront's built-in text instead.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Every write to properties, settings, roles, and permissions.
audit.empty: No audit entries match these filters.

diff.changedOnly: Only the fields that changed are recorded.
